package_info:
Name: sample-http-client
Version: 2.1.0
Summary: Pure Python HTTP client library (requests-like)
Home-page: https://github.com/example/sample-http-client
License: Apache-2.0
Requires-Python: >=3.9
Requires-Dist: urllib3>=1.26, certifi, charset-normalizer, idna

Build:
- Build-backend: setuptools.build_meta
- pyproject.toml present; no setup.py ext_modules
- No C, Cython, Rust, or Fortran sources
- Published wheels: sample_http_client-2.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
- No system library dependencies (no BLAS/LAPACK/OpenMP/CUDA)
- Pure Python package; source build needs only setuptools and wheel
jira_context: Investigate sample-http-client for RHAI packaging onboarding.
